home.titleStart: Hear the risk in your reel
home.lede: Upload a draft reel. Get every risky spoken claim with its timestamp, the rule it breaks and a safer line to say instead.

home.stepsTitle: From draft to safer take in three steps
home.step1Body: Gnani Prisma transcribes spoken Hinglish, with a timestamp for every line.
home.step2Body: Fixed rules catch clear-cut claims. Gnani Evon reviews the subtle ones.
home.step3Body: See each flag on the timeline, copy a safer line and hear a spoken summary from Gnani Timbre.

error.notFoundBody: This check does not exist, or it has expired.

report.partialBody: Gnani Evon could not review this transcript, so only the rule layer ran. Subtler claims may be missing.
report.cleanBody: No risky spoken lines were found.
report.formula: Start at 0. Add 35 per high flag, 15 per medium and 5 per low. Evon flags are multiplied by their confidence. Capped at 100. 0–24 is low, 25–59 medium and 60+ high.

about.title: How Bol Ke Check works
about.lede: Fixed rules catch the clear-cut phrases. Gnani Evon judges what rules cannot. Every flag records which layer raised it, so nothing is a black box.
about.rulesNote: Every rule shows “Pending review” until its ASCI clause has been checked and added as a source.
about.noEval: No evaluation has been run yet. Results will appear here after the first run on clips the rules were not written from.
about.partialEval: {{partial}} of {{clips}} clips ran without Gnani Evon, so these results partly reflect the rule layer alone.
about.disclaimer: Bol Ke Check is an automated pre-check. It flags risk and suggests safer wording. It is not legal clearance, and it is not affiliated with ASCI.
